classification: actual migrated PostgreSQL journal schema and two controlled unbroadcast intents; no chain write or fabricated email identity

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operation_journal_pkey ON public.operation_journal USING btree (operation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operation_journal_transaction_hash_key ON public.operation_journal USING btree (transaction_hash)
CREATE INDEX operation_journal_user ON public.operation_journal USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX operation_journal_recovery ON public.operation_journal USING btree (status, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX operation_journal_fair_recovery ON public.operation_journal USING btree (next_reconcile_at, last_reconciled_at) WHERE (acknowledged = false)
